title: fritillaria lusitanica subsp. neglecta
intro: Fritillaria lusitanica subsp. neglecta, commonly known as the Portuguese bellflower, is a plant species in the lily family. This perennial bulbous plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Fritillaria lusitanica subsp. neglecta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, saponins, and glycosides, such as veratridine and galanoside, that exhibit spasmolytic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities. The plant's health benefits make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine, particularly in the treatment of respiratory and inflammatory conditions.
